title: Objectwise finite underlying set models from locally constant modules and finite stalks
statement: Let X be a scheme, A a finite commutative ring, and F a sheaf of intrinsic A_X-modules [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site, def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf, def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Assume F is locally constant and has finite geometric module stalks [def-weil-proetale-locally-constant-sheaf, def-weil-proetale-geometric-stalk]. Then for every object U of X_proet there is an actual pro-etale covering presieve S of U such that for every arrow V→U in S the underlying set sheaf F|V is isomorphic to the constant sheaf of a finite set Z_V on the slice site [def-pur-localized-ringed-site].

source.place: Definition 093Q; finite local values from constant germs, Stacks Tags 099Y and 098K

proof.text: Use the proved intrinsic/fixed coefficient comparison: local constancy and finite intrinsic geometric stalks give finite local fixed-module models, including empty covering members. The finiteModels_over comparison gives such models on slice sites of a cover of the final object.

Pull this cover back along U→X. Stability under base change gives an actual covering presieve of U. Restriction of each model through Over.map is again the same constant fixed module, by constant-sheaf/slice comparison and functoriality of restriction.

Forget modules to sets. Constant sheafification commutes with this forgetful functor; its finite module model has a finite underlying set. The coefficient encoding has exactly the original underlying additive sheaf, so this is the required underlying set model of F.

lean.statement:
theorem proEtale_finiteUnderlyingModels_of_locallyConstant
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Finite A]
    (F : proEtaleRingModules X (proEtaleConstantRing X A))
    (hF : IsLocallyConstantProEtaleModuleSheafOfUniverses.{u, u} X A F)
    (hs : ∀ (Ω : Type u) [Field Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω] (x : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ X),
      Finite (proEtaleGeometricModuleStalk x (proEtaleConstantRing X A) F)) :
    ∀ U : X.ProEt, ∃ S : Presieve U, S ∈ ProEt.precoverage X U ∧
      ∀ (V : X.ProEt) (g : V ⟶ U), S g →
        ∃ Z : Type (u + 1), Finite Z ∧ Nonempty
          ((((sheafCompose (ProEt.topology X)
            (CategoryTheory.forget AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})).obj
              ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf _).obj F)).over V) ≅
            (constantSheaf ((ProEt.topology X).over V) (Type (u + 1))).obj Z)
